supported_claims.text: 安 means “peaceful” or “at ease.” A roof, 宀, stands over the figure written 女. One explanation of the early forms emphasizes a person seated securely indoors: a small added stroke marks the seated posture or its support. This connects the shape with being settled and comfortable.
The depicted building and seated figure combine to express ease. The exact motivation of the scene has more than one interpretation.

disagreements.text: The extra early stroke and its precise meaning remain open to interpretation. The familiar domestic stories also differ from the seating analysis. The shared idea of being at ease is clearer than one exact account of the character’s invention.
